content.content: Licence check, applied by reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs. Read the dependent's recorded decision against each recorded prerequisite in turn. (1) No element of the dependent may contradict the prerequisite it is read against: fail, naming the element and the prerequisite it contradicts, if any element of the dependent forbids, reverses or substitutes an outcome that prerequisite fixes, or narrows the prerequisite by excepting a case the prerequisite covers. (2) The same licence question is applied once per prerequisite — against rmovtvkt, against kwxutvpw, against rusopkql — by the same test, so the check holds only if the dependent contradicts none of them, and a failure names which prerequisite the offending element contradicts. (3) The check presumes no element of the dependent and no particular prerequisite clause; which element is at issue is a finding named only in the check's output. It requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the dependent, and invents no rule the prerequisites do not state. (4) A placeholder, empty or ref-less commitment in the dependent, or in a prerequisite the check is read against, leaves the check with no recorded subject: fail, naming the placeholder.
content.rationale: All four nodes involved are commitments in words: rmovtvkt, kwxutvpw and rusopkql are inline prose decisions (natural layer) and the dependent mwwxxzyk is an inline prose decision (natural layer), so every one of the three edges sits in the matrix's natural-to-natural gate cell (evals/natural-to-natural.md) and takes that cell's licence check, copied as the criterion. No cell of the matrix is missing for these edges, and the strictness rule confines the check to non-violation: a prose parent states no observables, so demanding behaviour of the dependent would exceed the licence these edges give, while a dependent in words is sound exactly when it contradicts none of its prerequisites. The uses the dependent makes are, per prerequisite: rmovtvkt for the four relationship sections whose listed ids are the entries this decision is about; kwxutvpw for the activation the entries rest on, this decision giving the entry the link affordance that activation needs while neither adding nor removing activation behaviour; and rusopkql for the case of a listed id naming no node, which must stay listed and must not gain an activation cue. One criterion covers all three uses because they ask one question of one dependent text — does it contradict a prerequisite it was drawn against — and splitting it per prerequisite would gate a single layer pairing three ways. Any probe of what the panel actually renders as a link would be an observable of a code-layer artifact and would gate a subject that is not recorded here, so the criterion stays a licence and non-contradiction check that survives rewriting the dependent without changing what it decides, defines nothing of the dependent and invents no rule the prerequisites do not state.
